title: Ignite 2026: baseline security mode for on-prem Exchange
summary: Microsoft announced an on-premises security initiative for supported Exchange Server, SharePoint Server and Skype for Business Server. It includes guidance that will appear in Secure Now, migration support and On-Premises Baseline Security Mode, intended to build more of Microsoft's recommended security settings into those server products. Microsoft lists three goals: get security updates to connected servers faster, make safer configurations easier to keep, and apply temporary protections against emerging threats until a permanent update ships. Security updates, hardening guidance, health tools and emergency mitigation exist today; the rest rolls out over time and varies by product.
why: On-premises Exchange and SharePoint remain frequent entry points in real attacks. A baseline mode built into the product could reduce configuration drift, but there are no versions or dates yet, so nothing here replaces patching or hardening you should already be doing.
todo: Do now: confirm every Exchange, SharePoint and Skype for Business server is on a supported release with the latest security update, and that Exchange Emergency Mitigation is enabled where supported.
Revisit which workloads can move to Microsoft 365; Microsoft explicitly continues to recommend it.
Wait: Baseline Security Mode for on-premises servers is announced without versions or dates — unverified. Track the linked Microsoft blog for specifics.
effective_note: Announced; capabilities roll out over time, availability varies by product — per Microsoft. No dates given.
